name: Fungal Flytrap

items.name: Quick Capture
items.text:
Trigger A creature hits or touches the flytrap.

---

Effect The flytrap makes a leaf Strike against the triggering creature. If it hits, the creature is Grabbed in that leaf.

items.name: Focused Assault
items.text: The flytrap attacks a single target with all four of its leaves. The flytrap makes one leaf Strike. On a success, the flytrap deals the damage from one leaf Strike plus an additional 1d8 damage for every leaf beyond the first. On a failure, the flytrap deals the damage from one leaf Strike. It deals no damage on a critical failure. This counts toward the flytrap's multiple attack penalty as a number of attacks equal to the number of leaves the flytrap has.

items.name: Greater Infestation
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 29 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 2d8 poison damage (1 round)

Stage 2 3d8 persistent,poison damage and can hear root rotter thoughts within 30 feet as an imprecise sense (2 rounds)

Stage 3 as stage 2, but 4d8 persistent,poison damage and arise as a root rotter upon death (2 rounds).

This replaces the Grab and Swallow Whole abilities possessed by giant flytraps.

items.name: Hungry Flurry
items.text: The flytrap makes four leaf Strikes at a -2 penalty, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the flytrap's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all its attacks.

text:
Because they blend in so well with surrounding foliage, giant flytraps can use the element of surprise to make quick strikes against unsuspecting adventurers and forest travelers.

---

Flytraps eagerly feed on humanoids, monstrous insects, and larger prey.
